description: scoring configuration for the structural affinity table. every weight and every facet crosswalk choice lives here, never in a code constant and never in a model. changing any value in this file is a versioned config change and changes the output hash.
notes: keys of facet_sources: the vocabulary field value for styles and wear contexts, the kind field for symbols. each entry says which record fields become facets, what class each facet lands in, and a per-field weight multiplier on top of the class weight.

facet names are shared across vocabularies on purpose. the planet field of a metal symbol and the ruler field of a zodiac sign land in the same feature namespace as style features, so celestial's moon and sun features meet the classical correspondences: metal_silver via planet moon, metal_gold via planet sun, cancer and leo via their rulers. this is the union lesson: a style-only pass strands celestial because its real neighbors are symbol-layer terms.

facet_merge max keeps the highest weighted intensity when two sources of the same term emit the same facet name (georgian carries ornate as both a feature and an axis, at equal values). this matches the reference cosine pass, where axes overwrite features of the same name with no numeric difference at equal weights.
the wear-context vocabulary contributes rows for coverage but carries no feature or axis content in v0.1, so its neighborhoods come out empty and are reported honestly rather than padded.
the crosswalk is structural only. links that need authored meaning, for example gothic toward the saturn or mars correspondences, are corpus authoring and stay out of the structural table.
default weights are 1.0 everywhere so v0.1 reproduces the reference cosine pass over the style file exactly. the knobs exist so later tuning is a config version bump, not a code change.
